newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Manipulation seen in SKorean Sam Yang, Orient shrs.
newsitem.headline: Manipulation seen in SKorean Sam Yang, Orient shrs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities Supervisory Board (SSB) said on Wednesday it had found an investor and a brokerage firm employee to have illegally manipulated share prices of Sam Yang Foods Co and Orient Co.
An SSB statement said that the shares of the two companies had risen sharply early this year due to the manipulation.

The SSB has reported the investor's case to the state prosecution and asked the brokerage firm, identified only as "L", to punish the employee involved, the statement said. It did not name either of the two people.
Orient's stock price rose steeply between April 15 and 27 due to manipulation by the brokerage firm employee, who illegally utilised customers' accounts, the statement said.
It also said Sam Yang's share price rose to 29,500 won from 24,000 between March 5 and 11 after an investor repeatedly placed high bids on the company's shares.
